description: Several Eastern European member states, frustrated by the failure of the Trusted Infrastructure Integration Directive and fearing deeper fragmentation, begin coordinating a parallel funding mechanism to jointly procure sovereign AI infrastructure and shared defensive tools outside EU channels. This informal bloc threatens to become a permanent fixture if EU-level cohesion does not recover.

An open-source collaboration using publicly available model weights publishes a novel protein-folding design tool that dramatically lowers the barrier to creating functional biological agents. The tool spreads rapidly through research and hobbyist communities, raising alarms about uncontrolled bio-risk proliferation even as it enables legitimate innovation.
